title: RC-19 test-file side: unit test files that, before the rails, imported src/utils/db, src/config or the notifier unmocked, so they opened and migrated the live DB, read the real .env values or could post to Telegram

evidence.note: static import of src/bot with no vi.mock at all: src/bot imports src/utils/db (src/bot.ts:52), src/config (:2) and the notifier (:50-51) unmocked
mocks txManager, logger, notifier and broadcaster only; the dynamic import of src/bot at :67 loads src/utils/db and src/config unmocked
bot.ts imports src/utils/db at module load
DB_PATH falls back to cwd/data/bot.db and new Database(DB_PATH) runs at import (the AUD-RAIL-002 mechanism)
dotenv.config() at import: CONFIG is built from the real .env values (vitest.config.ts:2-4 had already loaded them into process.env)
dotenv.config() and TELEGRAM_API built from the real TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN at import; sendTelegramAlert posts with axios

the test itself documents the reach: without the db mock every startChainAntiRugListener call "writes to the production data/bot.db singleton"; the notifier and config stay unmocked (detector.ts:94 imports sendCtxAlert)
detector imports the real sendCtxAlert; detectorEvaluator and detectorRegistry do not mock src/utils/notifier

evidence.ref: node scratchpad tools/reach.js over the slice-files.ts --snapshot TESTU tree and a git archive of src at 23a6461 (static import graph, vi.mock and vi.doMock targets not traversed)
evidence.note: lists, per test file, which of src/utils/db, src/config and src/utils/notifier are reached unmocked; the ledger rows with can_reach_real_state yes are exactly that list (importActual partial mocks checked by hand)
imports normalizeLegacyMainnetRows and makeIsTokenSnipedStmt from src/utils/db with no mock and no DB_PATH override
production cases import src/utils/db; the file header says the module "binds the real DB file via DB_PATH" (lpBaselineMigration and pauseStateMigration have the same cases)
the db mock targets ../../src/db (does not exist), so importing src/exitEngine loads the real src/utils/db and notifier (AUD-TESTU-023)

sibling_sites_checked: All 84 test/unit files at the base SHA, by static import graph (reach.js) plus reading every vi.mock / vi.doMock factory. db unmocked: bot/buyNonceLock, bot/twoStageSigint, configEnvVar, db.test, db/exitFailedHeldMigration, db/lpBaselineMigration, db/pauseStateMigration (the four db files point DB_PATH at a temp or :memory: path, see their rows). notifier unmocked: anti-rug/detectorEvaluator, anti-rug/detectorRegistry, bot/twoStageSigint, configEnvVar. config unmocked (real .env values in CONFIG): the rest of the rows marked yes. watchdog.test.ts loads the real notifier through vi.importActual but replaces both send functions, so it cannot post (labelled no). No unit test spawns a process, opens a non-loopback socket, uses worker_threads or dgram, or hard-codes a contacted real host (git grep over the snapshot for child_process, spawn, exec, fork, worker_threads, dgram, http.request, fetch(, new WebSocket, new JsonRpcProvider: the only hit is api/antiRug.test.ts:81-90, a 127.0.0.1 listener), so there is no new rail-class reach (D-16).
severity_rationale: Same severity and capital class as the canonical RC-19 entry AUD-RAIL-002 (S1 EXPOSURE): this is its test-file side, which AUD-RAIL-002 left for the TESTU audit to enumerate. Not a new escalation: it is linked to ESC-PRE-03 as a rediscovery (never escalated twice, PROTOCOL section 4). The SAFE-02 rails (22-05, 22-07..22-10) now block every listed reach; 22-29 re-audits them, so it stays a candidate.
recommendation: Keep the rails as the guard (no change in Phase 22). Phase 28: give every test that needs the database an explicit temp DB through the test helper, mock src/config with an explicit fixture instead of letting it read process.env, and mock the notifier in every file whose code under test can alert.
affected_cases: every case in the files listed under files
escaped_regression: Not a hidden-regression finding: the defect is the side effect itself. Example of what stays green while it happens: a change to src/utils/db.ts:9-24 that writes to the DB at import (for example a new migration step) runs against data/bot.db whenever bot/twoStageSigint.test.ts or bot/buyNonceLock.test.ts loads src/bot before the rails, and both tests still pass.
status_note: Stays candidate (its recommendation): the rails are the guard and Phase 28 cleans the test files.

triage.note: The 24 unit files the entry lists still import src/utils/db, src/config or the notifier unmocked, but each reach they had is refused under the rails: src/config and the notifier see only test/.env.test sentinels (every .env.example key; the named rail test), the src/utils/db import opens a per-worker temp database and never the live data folder (src and setup layers), and a Telegram send is refused before the network and blocked again by the network deny; status candidate -> fixed; removing the unmocked imports from those files stays Phase 28 hygiene, not a reach
triage.proof: Rail test sentinel env (D-02, AC-13) > every .env.example key in process.env equals its test/.env.test value (test/unit/rails/envSentinel.test.ts, marker closes-finding: AUD-TESTU-001); RED proof row 1 of .planning/phases/22-safety-rails-audit/red-proofs/INDEX.md (22-08-1-sentinel-env.txt), re-run on 2026-11-11 by 23-14 because the test file changed after that proof (069a30c): .planning/phases/23-test-safety-net-harness-triage-characterization/red-proofs/23-14-4-sentinel-env-unit.txt, with the sentinel values not loaded both sentinel tests fail, and test/rails/core.cjs was restored byte for byte; the live-DB reach is the marked rail test src tripwire on the live data folder (fires before the setup layer) > DB_PATH=./data/bot.db (RED row 10, re-run as 23-14-5-db-tripwire-src.txt); the Telegram reach is the marked rail test notifier refusal under Vitest (SAFE-02 src layer, D-04 amended) > sendTelegramAlert is refused through its catch path: no post, broadcast runs, ledger entry (RED row 14, 22-10-1-notifier-telegram.txt; src/utils/notifier.ts and that test file are byte-unchanged since the proof, and it was not re-run because removing the refusal would let the notifier attempt a real send); the entry's other RED rows: 2 to 9, 15 to 18
